items.source: Base class for a @Configuration class to set up the Elasticsearch connection using the ReactiveElasticsearchClient. This class exposes different parts of the setup as Spring beans. Deriving * classes must provide the ClientConfiguration to use.
items.translation: 配置类的基类，用于通过ReactiveElasticsearchClient设置 Elasticsearch 连接。该类将配置的各个部分暴露为 Spring Bean。派生*的类必须提供ClientConfiguration才能使用。

items.source: Provides the Elasticsearch transport to be used. The default implementation uses the RestClient bean and the JsonpMapper bean provided in this class.
items.translation: 提供要使用的 Elasticsearch 传输层。默认实现使用本类中提供的 `RestClient` Bean 和 `JsonpMapper` Bean。
